l.i: Cum supremum Doctoratus seu Magisterii Philosophici honorem
novem honestis ac literatis juvenibus publicè conferret,

main_text.l: LAUM DOBBINUM I. V. D. PRÆSTANTIS-

page.notes: Woodcut emblem below the text, between the title and the imprint: a laurel-wreathed head or mask over a scrolled cartouche with a row of ovals, not transcribed. Library oval/rectangular stamp ("BIBLIOTHECA REGIA ... HEIDELBERGENSIS") overlaps the right side of the text; not transcribed. Handwritten mark ("M" with a flourish) at the lower centre; not transcribed. The left edge of "ORATIO" and "SOLENNIS" is cut by the scan edge; the first letters are partly cropped but readable as printed. Printed "cIↄ. Iↄ. xc." appears as "cIↄ. Iↄ. xc." in the date lines and is converted to MDXC per the numeral rule. The "j" at the end of "Magisterij" is printed as a dotted i-form; given as "Magisterii" by the vowel rule.
